note: The bleached, overexposed heat COLOUR renders exactly - lifted brightness and gamma blow the top end, warm highlights, and saturation drops because strong sun washes colour out (measured YAVG 103 -> 119). The actual HAZE, the shimmer and refraction distortion the name promises, does nothing: no allowed filter can displace pixels. The heat haze entry in tags is a prompt hope. Use this for glare, not for shimmer.
